image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, leafless branch. The bird is facing right, displaying its characteristic black head with white mottling, orange-rufous breast and flanks, and black-and-white patterned wings. The background is a soft, out-of-focus grey/brown bokeh.
